name: who-flunet-activity-exceedance
grain: country x ISO week (ORIGIN_SOURCE streams summed)
systematic_rule: target country-year has >= 4 specimen-bearing weeks and >= 50% of them report INF_NEGATIVE >= 1; country-years judged systematic: 1258/3349
clustered_events_note: distinct_events counts country-years of the target week carrying at least one positive - positives arrive in seasonal clusters, so this is the effective sample size figure, per the candidate record

trap_acceptance.note: the discovery session measured 931/931 positive here; the pre-rule rate reproduces that uniform result, and the rule is judged by how few of those rows survive it

reference_baselines.note: stdlib rank AUC measured at construction on the written rows; scores are prediction-time-safe single features

crosscheck_hint: the built France 2024-25 positivity curve (summary.france_fixture) is the same series the publisher's FluNet chart app draws (worldhealthorg.shinyapps.io/flunetchart); the fixture asserts its peak and off-season levels from the source
